hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: In standard notation, a comma is inserted every 3 digits starting from the right.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Integers in [1000, 999999] have 1 comma, [1000000, 999999999] have 2 commas, and so forth.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Iterate over comma thresholds: start at 1000 and calculate the count of numbers in [1, n] exceeding each threshold.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def countCommas(n: int) -> int:
    commas = 0
    threshold = 1000
    while n >= threshold:
        commas += (n - threshold + 1)
        threshold *= 1000
    return commas
```

complexity.notes: Advances by factors of 1000, terminating in at most 6 iterations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Formatting every integer as a string takes O(n * log n) time and TLE.
